title: Fed vortices (new class fed-vortex), SIDE: in a gravity-free 2D fluid whose vorticity grows only by eating a regrowing fuel, vortices form from random vorticity, elongate as they feed and split into two vortices of the same sign, to generation 9-10 on 3/3 seeds (34/39/42 persistent splits, 24-26 after t=1000); all die within 70 t of a fuel fork; the no-advection reaction-diffusion twin freezes into a static spot lattice after generation 1-2
summary: world.py: 2D incompressible fluid (vorticity-streamfunction, periodic, no gravity, nothing marks a body or direction) with an ignition-like vorticity gain (k Y s - mu) omega, s = omega^2/(omega^2+wi^2), paid for by eating a diffusing fuel at e Y s omega^2 that regrows at kF. From band-passed random vorticity on uniform fuel 0.6, ~30 vortices of both signs form and drift in each other's flow; a vortex that feeds is stretched by its neighbours into a rod that pinches into two same-sign vortices (strips_s*.png), and same-sign vortices also fuse, so the population stays near 25 with a reticulate genealogy (merge/split 0.91-1.02). labkit packs (128^2, T=3000, 3 t frames): seeds 0/1/2 have 34/39/42 persistent splits, max generation 10/9/10, and keep splitting to the end (last split t=2853-2925); splits.py: daughters keep the parent's sign at 113/113 splits with known sign; 202 of 211 merges with known signs are same-sign fusions (9 opposite-sign contacts). World dt halved (0.02 -> 0.01, seed 0): 32 persistent splits, generation 9. Eight more seeds (3-10) all form 28-37 bodies by t=450. Fuel fork at t=2000 (fuel emptied, regrowth off): 28 -> 0 bodies between t=2025 and t=2070 on seeds 0 and 1, while the fed runs keep 23-27. No-advection twin (adv 0: the same reaction-diffusion, flow off): 54 frozen spots, 8 and 11 persistent splits, all during pattern formation (generation 2 and 1, 1 split after t=1000).

claims.statement: In seeds 0-2 a band-passed random vorticity field on uniform fuel becomes ~30 discrete vortices of both signs; vortices feed, are stretched into rods and split into two vortices of their own sign, repeatedly (generation 9-10, splits continuing to t~2900), while same-sign fusions balance the births; every vortex goes out within 70 t when the fuel is emptied, while the fed twin keeps 23-27.
claims.track: seed 0, track 256 (strips_s0.png, bottom row; pack/seed0/splits.json): a negative vortex of generation 9 that splits at t=2808 into tracks 266 and 267, both negative (generation 10); its ancestry is in pack/seed0/lineage.png, and it and every other vortex of seed 0 go out after the t=2000 fork in pack_fork/seed0

controls_run.E: pack_fork/ (fuel emptied and regrowth off at t=2000, seeds 0 and 1) against pack/ (fed, same seeds): efork.txt
controls_run.D: pack_dthalf/ (world dt halved, seed 0): 32 persistent splits, generation 9; pack_noadv/ (flow off)

claims.bd_control: pack_noadv/ (adv 0: the same vorticity-fuel reaction-diffusion with advection off, seeds 0 and 1): spots form and split only while the pattern forms (8 and 11 persistent splits, generation 2 and 1, one split after t=1000), then freeze into a lattice of 54; the fed fluid keeps dividing to generation 9-10. The twin lost ongoing D.

limits: E holds by construction: vorticity grows only by eating fuel and decays at mu without it (build-from-food plus decay), so the fork confirms rather than discovers it. The genealogy is reticulate: same-sign fusion is as common as fission (merge/split 0.91-1.02), so L6 confidence is capped at medium; daughters often fuse later with non-siblings. Bodies are vortices, not material: |omega| is the body field and there is no boundary layer. Vortices move only in their neighbours' flow (mutual advection); a +/- pair can travel as a dipole (20261027T0602-c53-fed-vortex-sighting), but M is not claimed. Fission needs the strain of neighbours; an isolated vortex does not split (sighting regime). 128^2 periodic only, one parameter point (kF 0.02, nu 0.1, Y0 0.6); no resolution test.
